forms.label: Whole pods, crushed
forms.sourceNote: Spices, cardamom (ground seed). Public domain. Used here for whole pods that are crushed and boiled with the tea, then strained out; the figures describe the seed matter inside the pod. USDA reports no sugars for this record, so sugarGPer100 is left off rather than estimated. No density: a crushed pod is packed, not poured.
